On the one hand, it's hard to get a full grasp of just how important and influential Backrooms will be in the grand scheme of A24 horror, considering that it only just released this past May. At the same time, the overwhelming success of Backrooms simply cannot be ignored, being the type of box-office juggernaut that has eclipsed every other A24 release, horror or otherwise. The sleeper hit film rose through the rankings to be A24's highest grossing film by over double the gross of the previous highest-grossing film.

This massive success can be attributed to numerous reasons, from the insistence and dedication of sticking to the artistic vision of a rising young filmmaker to building off of the name-brand recognition of a piece of internet horror that has been popular for years now. What cannot be denied is that Backrooms and its monumental level of success will assuredly influence how A24 operates and funds horror movies in the future. What this will specifically entail is still unknown, but at the very least, it means a sequel is in development.

Until that day, however, the clear choice for A24's most important and influential horror film is Hereditary, a film that has been a shining face of horror mastery over the past decade and the clearest example of A24's greatest strengths as an independent distributor. If the "elevated horror" concepts were established and initially popularized with The Witch, Ari Aster's multi-layered approach in Hereditary canonized the concepts of "elevated horror" into the cultural zeitgeist and made them synonymous with A24 as a brand.

No other horror film that A24 has released has had overwhelming financial success, as it was once A24's highest-grossing film, as well as the staying power to still be considered one of the major highlights of A24's filmography, horror or otherwise. Its success sent shockwaves through the industry and set a new standard for A24 horror that would be closely followed in the immediate future leading into the 2020s. The film was so fundamental to the continued success of A24 as an ambassador of horror that it's impossible to imagine what A24 would have done without its success.
